title: Hearty Crunchy Polish Potato Hash
description: A salty, crunchy, and cozy Polish dish featuring baby new potatoes, perfect for a low-glycemic diet. This recipe uses spherification to add a unique texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped potatoes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the potatoes are roasting, cook the chopped bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until it is crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet with a slotted spoon and set it aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until they are softened.
In a small bowl, mix the sodium alginate with 1 cup of water to create a spherification bath.
Once the potatoes are done roasting, let them cool slightly, then add them to the spherification bath and let them sit for 10 minutes.
After the potatoes have sat in the spherification bath, remove them with a slotted spoon and add them to the skillet with the onion and garlic.
Stir in the cooked bacon and chopped parsley, and serve the hash hot.
